ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 rider cancellation fee (no refund); no account flag required.
ruling.reasoning:
This is a rider-side cancellation dispute on a non-taxi RydeX booking, so NS-0 routes it through NS-4 (instant order, rider cancelled) [F4][NS-0]. The record shows matching at 08:40:00 and the rider's cancellation at 08:46:40, i.e. 6 min 40 s (400 s) after matching, which is more than the 3-minute free-cancellation window [F4][NS-4]. The $6.61 fee charged on record therefore stands [F7][NS-4].

The rider's stated reason — "plans changed and the driver had not even arrived" — is not a ground for waiver under NS-4: the rider's remedy for dissatisfaction is a RydeHELP appeal under NS-7, and Ryde publishes no free-cancellation rule for late-arriving drivers [F10][NS-4]. In any event the driver was within 200 m of the pickup from 08:41:25 and stationary 41 m away from 08:42:00 until the cancellation, having tapped "I'm Here" at 08:42:15 from 40 m, so the "not even arrived" premise is factually wrong [F1][F2][F3][F6][NS-4]. This also explains why the driver-side no-show branch is irrelevant: the trip was cancelled by the rider, not by the driver, so NS-1/NS-2 do not apply [F4][NS-0].

No refund or waiver follows: the fee is a Ryde-published cancellation fee, so FARE-1 is not breached [F7][FARE-1]. No account flag is warranted: the driver's here-tap was taken 40 m from the pickup, well inside range, and the two chat messages are complete and timestamped, so no NS-2 abuse condition is met [F6][F11][NS-2]. The rider's prior dispute history is 0 upheld and is not used to decide the case [F16][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read all chat messages, the driver's statement and the complaint — "At the pickup now, silver Toyota Altis," "Sorry, plans changed, I will cancel," and "I was parked at the pickup for minutes when the rider cancelled." None contains any threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. No traffic or weather factor is relevant here [F13][F14][F15][RD-4].
